title: Infinite-order $p$-adic differential equations for Hurwitz-type Euler zeta functions: Uniqueness and higher-dimensional extensions
summary: We generalize the one-dimensional infinite-order linear differential equation satisfied by the $p$-adic Hurwitz-type Euler zeta function (Abh. Math. Semin. Univ. Hambg. 91: 117--135, 2021) to $n$ variables. By encoding the differential operator as a convolution with a distribution kernel, we introduce partial zeta functions and partial operators indexed by subsets of $\{1,\dots,n\}$.
